name: Türkiye Burslari (YTB)
covers: Tuition, housing, monthly stipend ($300-500), health insurance, Turkish language course
notes: No application fee. Priority given to conflict-affected students. Arabic support available. One of the most Gaza-friendly scholarships.
visa_notes: Palestinian passport accepted. Turkish embassy in Amman or Cairo processes visas.

name: Jordan Humanitarian Admission — Gaza
covers: Tuition, housing support, some universities include stipend
notes: Arabic instruction available. Fastest pathway for Gaza students. Rolling admission means you can apply anytime. Strong humanitarian priority.
visa_notes: Palestinian passport accepted. Very high feasibility. Jordanian universities have dedicated Gaza student programs.

name: Stipendium Hungaricum
covers: Tuition, housing, monthly stipend (~€180), health insurance
required_documents: English proficiency proof or waiver request
notes: Humanitarian English waiver possible for Gaza students. Apply through Palestinian Ministry of Education as nominating authority.
visa_notes: Palestinian passport accepted. Hungarian embassy in Cairo or Amman.

name: HEC Pakistan — Gaza Priority Scholarship
covers: Tuition, housing, monthly stipend, health coverage
notes: Arabic-friendly environment. Pakistani universities have large Muslim student communities. Humanitarian priority for Gaza students.
visa_notes: Palestinian passport accepted. Pakistani embassy in Cairo or Amman handles visas.

name: Malaysian Technical Cooperation Programme (MTCP)
covers: Tuition, accommodation, monthly allowance, return airfare
notes: Graduate level only. Strong Muslim-friendly environment. No IELTS required. Return airfare included.
visa_notes: Palestinian passport accepted. Malaysian embassy in Cairo processes visas.

name: DAAD Development-Related Postgraduate Courses
covers: Monthly stipend (~€850), health insurance, travel allowance. Tuition varies.
notes: High English requirement. Partial funding only — university tuition may apply. Visa process moderately complex for Palestinian passport.
visa_notes: Palestinian passport — German embassy in Cairo or Amman. Visa process can take 3-4 months. Moderate risk.
